project.name: TWINFORGE — Une décision. Deux futurs.
project.productType: Civil counterfactual collision intervention lab with explicit Meta proposal verification

typography.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
typography.mono: SF Mono, ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

design.density: One primary synchronized comparison, bounded controls and measured consequences; compact desktop and stacked phone scene

preferredPrimitives: Native buttons, inputs and accessible segmented tabs
Existing Three.js renderer with deterministic measurements
HTML metric cards and canvas chart

must: At least 44px touch targets and visible keyboard focus.
Only calculated metrics and geometry; freeze paths before replay.
State that initial state and known planar contact law are supplied.
Identify the arbitrary experiment threshold and instantaneous actuator assumption.
Show failed proposals, sensitivity failures and absence of a passing tested action.
No independent accuracy claim for same-model replay.
Keep local scanner frames on device and separate pixels from physical units.
avoid: Claiming real robotic control or reconstruction from synthetic inputs.
Presenting deterministic search as a Meta model invocation.
Keeping water/orbit in the main product.

decisions: User rejected the water-tank main example and orbit. They are removed from the public presentation; historical source and evidence remain archived.
Use the four previously retrieved 21st source patterns as native HTML/CSS primitives, composed around two synchronized causal branches.
Civil industrial scenario: compare 37 one-command interventions, show a discrete intervention-time limit and three speed sensitivity checks.
Keep model proposals, numerical verification, local exhaustive-search baseline and recorded/new provider sessions distinct.
Retain the mobile camera tool as local image-plane tracking, separate from supplied-state 3D simulation.
evidence: Four 21st previews visually inspected during the design pass, with code stored in .21st/cache.
Source names, registry URLs and hashes recorded in .21st/sources.json.
Actual CSS tokens read from web/process/lab.css.
Native adaptation provenance is named in index.html and web/process/lab.css.
